answer_1.quote: This study focuses on the topic of LLMs Assist NLP Researchers, particularly examining the effectiveness of LLM in assisting paper (meta-)reviewing and its recognizability.

answer_2.quote: We propose a novel metric to measure LLM-generated review diversity ... named ITF-IDF ... we compute the F1 on each paper then average across papers ... calculate ROUGE and BERTScores

answer_3.quote: This section evaluates if prompting popular LLMs (both closed-and open-source) can solve this problem. ... we employ two prompting strategies: 1) Labeling-All ... 2) Select-Deficient

answer_4.quote: Our annotator team consisted of 40 members from the NLP community ... For detailed analysis, reviews were segmented by sentences, and annotators were asked to label each sentence (a) whether it is Deficient, and (b) provide an explanation if it is.
answer_4.guideline: Sentences that contain factual errors or misinterpretations of the submission; Sentences lacking constructive feedback; Sentences that express overly subjective, emotional, or offensive judgments; Sentences that describe the downsides of the submission without supporting evidence.
